description: Where is an object in its workflow(s)? For objekt_typ + objekt_id (e.g. deal + Pipedrive id 1000 = DN 1000): current node, since when, overdue?, the node's agent_info (what to know/do/check there), rollen (trigger, what happens, who does it today: human/code/AI), the regular next node(s) given the object's data, hand-overs into other workflows (weiter_in), open preparations (vorbereitungen: angefragt|bereit|angepasst) and the last events (moves, resets with reason, who, evidence). Read-only. Call this BEFORE acting on a deal.

objekt_typ.description: Type of the object (e.g. deal, lead, project)

name: get_workflow_status
